title: Float32 embedding decoding and malformed payload rejection
pins: Whether OpenAI and Mistral embedding payloads become the intended numeric vector or a deliberate library exception. Silently truncating corrupt bytes or admitting non-finite floats poisons downstream similarity calculations; a TypeError denies consumers their normal PrismException recovery path.
scope: Numeric array passthrough and canonical base64 little-endian float32 decoding. Does not cover model quality, dimension selection, index sorting, quantized Mistral output types or live provider behavior.
findings: Recorded from the PHP reference fixing Particle-Academy/prism#71. The TS/Python columns have no runner for this corpus and remain unverified; their null columns do not claim agreement. The PHP runner exercises both provider handlers against vendored cases.

discrimination.note: Numeric and fixed-byte controls reject a decoder that always throws; partial floats, NaN, infinity and malformed base64 reject permissive decoders. Independent PHP tests assert the fixed-byte expected vector before recording goldens.
